name: Pita Falafel
description: Warm fluffy pita packed with green herbaceous falafel, creamy tahina, tangy amba mango sauce, pickled cabbage, and fresh herbs.

name: Pita Shewarma
description: Spit-roasted spiced chicken sliced thin, stuffed with tahina, amba, chopped Israeli salad, grilled onions, and roasted Anaheim chile.

name: Plate Falafel with Hummus & Mejadra
description: Crisp green falafels, velvety house hummus, warm wood-fired pita, spiced mejadra rice with lentils, and chopped herb salad.

name: Plate Chicken Shewarma with Hummus
description: Slow spit-roasted chicken shawarma over creamy warm hummus, served with fresh pita, grilled Anaheim pepper, and Israeli salad.

description: Silky house-whipped chickpea hummus topped with whole warm chickpeas, olive oil, paprika, and 2 fresh warm pitas.

name: Moroccan Harira Soup
